scope: chat:is romaine lettuce regulated under this quarantine?

gemini.value:
The sources state that regulated articles include those listed at the specified APHIS website, or any other product, article, or means of conveyance determined by an inspector to present a risk of spreading fruit flies [7cfr301_32#011]. 

The sources don't settle this. Romaine lettuce is not mentioned in the provided passages. It is missing whether romaine lettuce appears on the APHIS host list or if an inspector has determined it presents a risk of spreading fruit flies. Confirm with USDA APHIS, the San Diego County Agricultural Commissioner, or CDFA.
